register.formality: 합니다체 for sentences (formal polite, as Jira and Azure DevOps Korean UIs write); labels and buttons are nouns (저장, 삭제).
register.note: Western punctuation. A sentence-final ellipsis is "…". Particles after a {placeholder} are written to read correctly for any value (prefer (이)가 / (을)를 forms or rephrase).

Sprint.source: messages/zh.json issueViews.sprint ("Sprint", kept Latin) and story MOTIR-7730 copy rules
Sprint.note: Kept in Latin script by decision, in every language. DELIBERATE: Korean Jira writes 스프린트; Motir keeps the Latin "Sprint" as Chinese already does, knowing that convention. Do not write 스프린트.
